objectives: Introduce statistics in the context of contemporary business. Emphasizing statistical literacy in thinking and how to apply its concepts with real data and examples to develop a deeper conceptual understanding.
content:
Statistics, Data, and Statistical Thinking (Chapter 1)

Methods for Describing Sets of Data (Chapter 2)

Probability (Chapter 3)

Midterm Exam

Random Variables and Probability Distributions (Chapter 4)

Sampling Distributions (Chapter 5)

Inferences Based on a Single Sample: Estimation with Confidence Intervals (Chapter 6)
books:
Title: Statistics for Business and Economics (2022, 14th Edition)
Author: James T. McClave , P. George Benson, Terry Sincich
Publisher: Pearson
